title: fix(validate): refuse in seconds when mypy is missing (GH-1519)
body_excerpt: ## Summary Closes #1519. `validate.sh`'s existing GH-732 environment check now also requires `mypy` (`test/test_python_layer.py` runs `python3 -m mypy`). Without it the gate exits 3 at once with `missing modules: mypy` and `pip install -r requirements-dev.txt`, instead of failing one test after a ~13-minute full run. With mypy present nothing changes; hosted jobs that run `validate.sh` already install `requirements-dev.txt`. **Draft because independent review did not finish:** Codex final QA reached its 3-round cap with one open provenance nit (rows 4–5 of `provenance.jsonl` lacked an exit code and an exact command). Both were fixed after round 3 (`b75c282ff`) without a fourth round; per run rules a fourth round needs the operator. The code verdict itself passed in every round. ## Prior-Art & Ground Truth - [x] **Prior-Art Search Run**: `rg -n "yaml pytest requests|missing modules" validate.sh test/` — one existing check (GH-732) to extend; `test/gh251-validate-pytest-skip.sh` pins only prefixes that still match. - [x] **Grounded Recon**: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and `wave-reconcile.yml` install `requirements-dev.txt` before every `validate.sh` run. ## Proof of Done - [x] **Mechanical Verification Command**: manual check `TESTS-RESULTS/2026-11-19+GH-1519/smoke.log` + `provenance.jsonl` (no new suite, GH-831); full pre-push gate GREEN on `eea4c81a0`. - [x] **Test Output**: without mypy `bash validate.sh --print-mode` → rc=3 in 0s naming mypy; with mypy rc=0; `test/gh251-validate-pytest-skip.sh` 4 pass; pre-fix red control (same python, `ad22311e8`) → rc=0, no refusal. ## Governance & PDDA - [x] **Linked Issue**: Closes #1519 - [x] **Capture Doc Updated**: none (two-line fix); PRS row `rated 60/40/50/95`. - [x] **No Hardcoded Machine Paths**: none added. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.
